message.content:
You are an adversarial verifier for a proposed STRUCTURAL refactor in the andesim repo at /home/nick/work/andesim.
READ-ONLY: do not edit, build, or run anything. Use Read/Grep/Glob only.

Claim (from reviewer driver-run):
- file: driver/run_plan.cpp:253
- category: naming
- title: lm_suffix also carries the L2C MMIO base; name and {plugin_args} comment say 'LM' only
- detail: plan_argvs builds a comma-suffix named lm_suffix (run_plan.cpp:253) from ilm_size/dlm_size/hvm_size AND l2c_base (line 257) - the L2C platform-cache MMIO window base, which is not a local memory. The comment describing the composed {plugin_args} (lines 284-286) likewise says 'plus the LM sidecar-drain args', omitting the l2c token. The name predates the shared-cache descriptor work (commit ff583f3). Renaming to e.g. hw_suffix (and amending the comment) restores intent; it is a function-local variable with zero external visibility.
- claimed safety: Local-variable rename plus comment fix; the produced plugin_args string is byte-identical.

Try to REFUTE it. For dead-code: grep the WHOLE repo (and the demo suite at /home/nick/work/andesim-demo, and consider that vsim lives in a separate repo /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim - grep there too if the symbol could cross repos) for references. For duplication: read both sites fully and check they really are behavior-identical. For stale-doc: read the doc AND the code it describes. For bug-report: check whether the behavior is actually wrong vs intended. If the change could alter ANY observable behavior (output text, exit codes, file layout, test expectations), verdict RISKY with the exact risk. If the claim is wrong, REJECTED. Only CONFIRMED when you verified the evidence yourself.

commit ff583f3eb8b6ace7bc28a3e5002ccec7c63e53d3
Author: Nick Hung <nick@andestech.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 15 08:24:53 2026 +0800

    feat(driver): shared-cache descriptor drives the plan's l2c_base + policy-mask verify + CACHE column (behavioral)
    
    Engines now advertise their platform cache (--describe
    shared_cache_level/base/size_kb: L2C on 45-series, L3C on 46/66, absent
    on size-0 RTL builds). The descriptor carries it, the hybrid plan grows
    the plugin token l2c_base=<engine's MMIO base> only when present -- the
    drain window follows the ENGINE, and the resolved plan (--dry-run) is
    the demo/sweep gate, same scheme as ilm/dlm/hvm_size. `list engines`
    appends a CACHE column (L3:512K on ax66_makatau, - elsewhere), the
    level gate for the split L2C/L3C demo tests.
    
    The l2c.ctrl verify compare narrows from ~INITSTATUS[14] to the ABI's
    HYBRID_L2C_CTRL_POLICY_MASK: the resume side merges only policy bits
    [7:0] over the target's live Control, so the RTL-owned RAM-timing bits
    differ from the QEMU oracle's stub BY CONSTRUCTION and must not
    false-diff (live on ax66: drain 0x80D vs oracle 0x0D, compare 0x0D).
